name: demo-project
body: Demo project: the repo contains a small, non-EY-branded demo eypres project at `examples/demo/` (eypres.yaml, slides/, assets/, templates/) with a few slide templates (e.g. title, content, columns), a few section templates (e.g. column, person), one theme and at least one media file under templates/media/. It is the fixture for integration/e2e tests of template loading, validation, rendering and media serving, and is distinct from the minimal `hello` init seed (which stays minimal). It is not embedded in the binary. AC: `eypres start` in `examples/demo/` validates templates and deck cleanly; integration tests run against it; grep of `examples/demo/` finds no EY brand name, font or logo.
